notes.title: Patch Notes - Jan 17 2024
notes.content:
[b]Gel Blast[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed various bugs and controls have been improved
[*]The menu is now updated when language is changed
[*]The High Score achievement now only requires 250,000 points
[*]The music track is now the original Turbo's Gel Blast track composed by Tori Kamal, the voice of the male characters in the game. I hated the other one but if you still want to use it, the game uses gelblast_alt.bgm instead of gelblast.bgm now.
[/list]

notes.title: March 2 - Small Update
notes.content:
Leowald Patch Notes
[list]
[*]The Undertunnels and The Ruins have a new look.
[*]Batty and Lobber now do 4 damage instead of 8 before Act 2 as intended.
[*]Updated Spine assets to latest version in anticipation of new content.
[*]Sea Dragon's Ring now only requires 3mv to use.
[*]Fixed more Abridged Mode bugs.
[*]Fixed some dialogue issues.
[*]Reduced ring power experience requirements.
[*]Reduced weapon experience requirements.
[*]Increased the effectiveness of the Weaponmaster and Experience Share rings.
[*]Misc fixes and changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Changes and Updates
notes.content:
Leowald Update Notes
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Anbiru not wanting to upgrade armor.
[*]Heart drop rate has been increased.
[*]Abridged Mode now applies to Marauder Mode as well. Destroyer Mode still has every full map available.
[*]Enemies in and before Castle Archives now do less damage.
[*]Chests have had their rewards greatly improved. If you have a save in progress at this time, you may want to restart or start on New Game Plus. You can still complete the game with your current save but you may not obtain some items until you restart.
[*]Krempel no longer sells his three heart-giving items. Instead, nine chests have been changed to contain a heart piece.
[*]Master Geldan no longer goes quite as ham in Gel Blast.
[*]Toggle Minimap is now mapped to the "Select"/"Share" button on controllers by default
[*]The music track for Castle Archives has been changed. Owners of the soundtrack can find the original in the demos folder.
[*]The music track for Moonlight Glade has been changed. Owners of the soundtrack can find the original in the demos folder.
[/list]

notes.title: Bard Mode Update: Abridged Maps
notes.content:
Are the huge areas like Kaniokole Volcano and Sky Dragon Isle getting to you? Bard Mode now has the abridged version of the game's maps, meaning most connecting rooms without treasure have been removed. Overall, there are about 25% fewer rooms to get through.

Marauder Mode and Destroyer Mode still have all the original rooms intact.

Enjoy!

tags.feature: Bard Mode now has the abridged version of the game's maps, meaning most connecting rooms without treasure have been removed.

notes.title: The Great Plain is here!
notes.content:
Rip has called it quits! Take a right outside of Henrik and Tilli's house and you'll end up in The Great Plain, a new area connecting Leowald to all the areas he went to. Adventure awaits!

There are also some small bug fixes in this patch.
- Gelder Counter is now hidden during area transitions when shown on the HUD
- Some text changes

notes.title: Leowald is here! Have some bug fixes.
notes.content:
Get Leowald while the launch discount is going on. You'll be the coolest of your friends.

Some changes in tonight's patch:
- New option: Show Gelder On HUD
- New Heart Stone added to Kaniokole Volcano
- A room in early Sky Dragon Isle was made a bit easier
- Shock Gels no longer fire shock bullets
- Harriet now fires shadow shots in four directions instead of six
- Various bug fixes
- Fixed Camera is a little less... fixed

Make sure to stop by the official MTC Discord if you're into that sort of thing for updates, discussion, drawing, and other stuff:

http://discord.gg/tPf9C8K
